confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated 2026 cost-of-living listings (MyLifeElsewhere, Whereandwhen, Nomad Ranker) and are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine are less certain: the cocktail figure comes from one downtown club listing, and the wine anchor is derived from the local beer price using a restaurant markup assumption, not from a found glass price. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no accommodation prices were searched or checked against live listings. FX is the latest RBA observation I could verify (20 March 2026), not the November 2026 rate; a later rate was not found on rba.gov.au in the searches run, so this observation is stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Romanian university and tourism city; compared with other Central and Eastern European cities of similar size and price level, with food prices anchored to local 2026 listings.
